title: Up date..Do not last, there Junk..
text:
Up date..Do not last, there Junk... Up date. Have 3 of these stool for a 1 1/2 months at my kitchen counter that the 4 yr old sits at, and the back
Of theses are falling apart..The company just says thanks for letting us know!
Not exceptable...Do Not buy these, as they are junk, Not made well, but look good..
—————-

Good looking bar stool for the price.
I measured the height of my other bar stools to make sure there 24 in Tall and these are the right size stools I needed for my kitchen eating bar..Right on.
Although I think the back could be taller but fit my back very comfortable
The stools do not take up allot of space.

The instructions made it easy to put together, but the little tool they give you would have taken my husband forever
To put this together.
My husband used a Allen head screw driver with different size heads on it, which made it allot easier to put this together.

The seat is Very Comfortable Not hard, as the back is comfortable also, the color of the wood makes this look more expensive.
The stool does Not look cheesy, as it’s made very good.
The Swivel seat is not real stiff, swivels good, the back fits my back very nice, and comfortable.
The taps on the bottom of the legs, do Not scratch my wood floor, and move smooth, but not slippery.

I honestly cannot say anything bad about this bar stool.
Just ordered Two More"

This was packaged very good, Not a scratch on the wood.

5 star.I recommend these bar stools

product_metadata.title: Ball & Cast Swivel Counter Height Barstool 24 Inch Seat Height Black Set of 1
features: Classic, casual, counter-height bar stool made of durable, solid hardwood; ideal for a kitchen island, counter, or bar
Cushioned seat and curved back comfortably padded with high-density foam and covered with easy-care black faux leather
Swivels 360 degrees in either direction; premium ball bearings promote quiet and effortless rotation; flared legs and circular footrest for added stability
A seat band beneath the cushion hides the swivel component for a polished appearance
description: Create a welcoming space with help from this counter-height swivel bar stool. Ideal for a kitchen island, counter, or bar, the swiveling stool rotates into place, making it easy to sit down or stand, plus it helps promote smooth-flowing conversation—effortlessly turn and talk to guests in multiple directions (no need to stand or scooch the chair around).
